games.title: Brain-Dead Redemption
games.resume: In this interactive animation, you play as a brain-dead person experiencing sleep paralysis.

games.title: The lumi-organ thief got a hangover
games.resume: A gay bar, a pretty dumb cop, a kid who practices black magic, and an alien organ trafficker... Will you be able to solve the mystery of this cursed village ?

games.title: Lumiflash

games.title: Lumipodes contre la tyrannie
games.resume: The game takes place during the time when the tyrant rules over Citopode. You play as the kitchen assistant to the Lumipode witch. Step by step, learn the magic of potions until you can overcome death itself to defeat the tyrant.
